title: Dialspin
generation_prompt: Original all-ages synthwave instrumental for a beginner-friendly one-or-two-key electronic rhythm game at a STRICT constant 120 BPM in 4/4 for 128 seconds. Keep a FULLY AUDIBLE quantized retro drum machine at final-mix level from the FIRST SECOND to the final bar: a short strong kick on EVERY quarter note, a dry prominent snare on every beat two and four, crisp closed eighth-note hats, and one distinct short midrange bell-key or woodblock attack on EVERY beat including the first 16 seconds and the entire middle. Do not fade, filter, swing or half-time the main beat; no silent intro, sparse ambient breakdown, drum dropout, tempo drift, free-time passage or smeared reverb that hides attacks. Signature hook: four clipped analog-synth notes circle upward in narrow steps, pause for one eighth-note, then two brighter chime-key notes answer down an octave on the opposite stereo side. Keep the motif and beat markers clearly separate above round pulsing bass and restrained short minor-to-major chord stabs. At the midpoint maintain the same drum grid, lead with the lower chime answer and shift the analog call to a brighter register; the ending combines both motifs in a new cadence rather than copying the opening. One evolving 128-second stereo instrumental, colorful and buoyant with controlled high frequencies, no abrasive distortion. No vocals, speech, sampled recordings, known melody or imitation of an existing song.
cover_prompt: Create a brand-new SQUARE 1:1 original duohertz album cover for Dialspin, an all-ages synthwave rhythm-game track. High-contrast editorial comic-print collage: ONE oversized blank warm-ivory synthesizer control dial seen from a slightly tilted top-down view dominates the square, with a single electric-cyan pointer notch at its rim. Behind it, exactly three broad coral-red paper wedges radiate outward at unequal angles like successive beat positions, and one small cyan waveform fragment slips between two wedges. Near-black ink ground, thick tactile cut-paper shadows, restrained halftone, one tiny warm-yellow spark. The dial should be an original simple shape, not a branded device, record or turntable. Clear silhouette at 100px, calm dark lower fifth for local title overlay. No numbers, ticks that form a clock, letters, words, logos, screen, cassette, car, city, person, watermark or copied game art.
og_prompt: Edit the supplied original Dialspin square cover into a HORIZONTAL 1.9:1 duohertz social-sharing card. Preserve one giant blank warm-ivory synthesizer control dial with a single electric-cyan pointer notch, exactly three unequal coral paper beat wedges behind it, one small cyan waveform fragment, near-black comic-print field and sparse halftone. Recompose the dial and wedges on the RIGHT two-thirds, leaving calm dark space on the LEFT. Add exactly two crisp fully legible English lines there: 'duohertz' in lowercase electric cyan and 'Dialspin' in larger warm ivory. Spell both exactly. Make a purpose-built wide card, not a stretched square crop. No other text, letters, numbers, clocks, records, turntables, people, logos, watermark or copied game art.
